Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Appointment Of Secretarial Auditor

analysis.summary: Vidya Wires is a manufacturer of winding and conductivity products, currently holding a 5.70% market share of installed capacity. The company is executing an expansion project to increase its production capacity to 37,680 MT per annum, aiming to become India's 3rd largest manufacturer. Management is focusing on diversifying its product portfolio, expanding into renewable energy and EV sectors, and increasing its export revenue share. The company is also prioritizing debt reduction to improve its financial flexibility.

margins_costs.claim: The company utilizes a back-to-back copper booking and hedging model to manage risk.
margins_costs.quote: Back-to-Back copper booking as well as copper hedging
